hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

primary.description: Official Dark Blue of E.C.P, used for sidebar, headers, and primary buttons.

secondary.description: Official Yellow of E.C.P, used for kinetic triggers, warning states, and accents.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Dashboard)

surface_strategy.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), rounded-xl, shadow-sm.
surface_strategy.sidebar: Flat solid background (#0A192F), text-white/70, active items text-white with left yellow border.
surface_strategy.header: Solid background (#FFFFFF) with a hard bottom border (border-slate-200), sticky top z-50.

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#0A192F] text-white hover:bg-[#112240]. Accent buttons: bg-[#FACC15] text-[#0A192F] hover:bg-[#EAB308] font-bold.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables. Clean borders, left-aligned data. Use right-alignment for financial values.
components.forms: Shadcn inputs and selects. Label text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700. Input border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A192F].
components.charts: Recharts. Use primary (#0A192F) and secondary (#FACC15) colors. Tooltips must be dark.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs, h-auto override, transparent background with bottom border indicator for active state.
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Active Athlete: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800.

login_background.description: Spacious soccer stadium with green field, used for login screen background with a dark blue overlay.

player_placeholder.description: Dynamic scene of amateur soccer players, used for blank states or onboarding cards.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Dark blue on white and yellow on dark blue.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Install and use 'lucide-react' (default) or '@phosphor-icons/react' for sport-themed iconography.
Create a responsive Sidebar layout. On mobile, use a hamburger menu that opens a Shadcn Sheet containing the sidebar.
Implement the Dashboard with KPIs (Cards) for Active Athletes, Completed Trainings, Matches, Income, Expenses, and Balance.
Integrate Recharts for: Income vs Expenses (Bar/Area), Trainings per month (Line), Match results (Pie).
Ensure the color palette accurately reflects E.C.P: Dark Blue (#0A192F) and Yellow (#FACC15).
Implement full CRUD logic for Athletes, Trainings, Matches, Sponsors, Income, and Expenses.
Ensure the data tables have pagination and action dropdowns (Edit/Delete).
Do not use transparent headers over scrollable content. Keep the Topbar solid white.
Use the 'Barlow' font for all headings to give it a structured, athletic feel, and 'Manrope' for body text.
